282246248.description: This lot features eight sealed VHS-C camcorder tapes from Maxell, TDK, and JVC. Included are Maxell TC-30 Premium High Grade HGX-Gold tapes in gold packaging, TDK TC-30 HG Ultimate tapes with blue and gold packaging, and JVC TC-30 PROHF and TC-30 EHG tapes labeled High Energy in gold/black and blue/black boxes. These tapes are compatible with VHS-C camcorders and come in a variety of packaging colors.

282102468.description: This collection includes approximately 24 assorted mineral and rock specimens featuring quartz crystals, geodes, jasper, and other various types. The pieces display natural, unpolished surfaces with rough edges and varying colors and shapes. Some specimens show minor surface wear consistent with natural formation and handling. The set was originally sold by Goodwill and offers a diverse selection for mineral and rock enthusiasts.

282768703.description: This lot includes two natural mineral specimens perfect for collectors. The first piece is a polished blue agate geode slice featuring a crystalline druzy center with banded blue, white, and dark quartz formations and a flat base for upright display. The second specimen is a raw matrix rock displaying a cluster of natural white and cream-colored crystal formations embedded in a gray stone base with natural jagged crystal points. Both specimens are in good display condition and showcase authentic geological formations ideal for mineral and gemstone enthusiasts.

282436134.description: Set of 6 sealed spindles of RiDATA DVD-R 16X Inkjet White NSR discs. Each spindle contains 50 discs with 4.7GB capacity and 120 minutes recording time. Discs are hub printable for use with inkjet printers. Designed to resist scratches, fingerprints, dust, and sunlight damage on the data side. Brand new, still wrapped in original plastic, made in Vietnam. Model details and branding are visible. Excellent unused condition.

Solid American walnut construction with rich natural wood grain throughout
Accommodates up to six smoking pipes with carved base rests and circular top cutouts
Brown felt protective base retains original Duk-It and Genuine American Walnut foil labels
Measures 6 inches long by 6 inches wide and 5.5 inches tall

Rendered in a distinctive regional folk art tradition with rich carved texture and painted accents, this large figural piece showcases expressive facial detailing, rolled trousers, bare feet, and a shoulder-slung woven basket satchel.
Hand-carved solid wood construction with painted highlights and rich stained finish
Expressive character depiction holding a pipe and harvesting tool with shoulder pouch
Carved integral wooden pedestal base for sturdy upright display
Measures approximately 32 inches high, 7.5 inches wide, and 6.5 inches deep; weighs 8 lbs
Condition:
